definition: Buried and sealed away, usually within a tomb or enclosed place.
book: The Fall of the House of Usher
author: Edgar Allan Poe
quote: And, round about his home, the glory That blushed and bloomed Is but a dim-remembered story, Of the old time entombed.
example_sentence: The fossil had been entombed in rock for millions of years.
